lines.text: Most access in your company no longer belongs to a person.
Service accounts, cloud keys and AI agents hold it now. And attackers have noticed.

adapID Continuous Identity Risk Management learns how every identity works, scores each session as it happens, and holds the one that doesn’t belong.
A cloud access key, pushed to a public code repository. Within minutes, someone else was using it.
adapID NHI Security finds every role and key in AWS, removes the access they never use, and catches the one that starts behaving differently.
A customer on a video call, frightened into paying a fake officer.
